title: Provably Reliable Classifier Guidance via Cross-Entropy Control
abstract: arXiv:2601.21200v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Classifier-guided diffusion models generate conditional samples by augmenting the reverse-time score with the gradient of the log-probability predicted by a probabilistic classifier. In practice, this classifier is usually obtained by minimizing an empirical loss function. While existing statistical theory guarantees good generalization performance when the sample size is sufficiently large, it remains unclear whether such training yields an effective guidance mechanism.   We study this question in the context of cross-entropy loss, which is widely used for classifier training. Under mild smoothness assumptions on the classifier, we show that controlling the cross-entropy at each diffusion model step is sufficient to control the corresponding guidance error. translated_title: 通过交叉熵控制实现可证明可靠的分类器引导
translated_abstract: 分类器引导的扩散模型通过将概率分类器所预测对数概率的梯度添加到逆时间得分上，来生成条件样本。在实践中，该分类器通常通过最小化经验损失函数获得。尽管现有的统计理论在样本量足够大时能够保证良好的泛化性能，但这种训练是否能够产生有效的引导机制仍不清楚。我们在交叉熵损失的框架下研究这一问题，交叉熵损失是分类器训练中广泛使用的损失函数。在对分类器施加温和的光滑性假设下，我们证明控制扩散模型每一步的交叉熵足以控制相应的引导误差。特别地，达到条件KL散度 ε² 的概率分类器所诱导的引导向量具有 Õ(dε) 的均方误差，最高至……
tldr: 本文证明了对分类器交叉熵损失的控制足以约束扩散模型中分类器引导的误差，从而为基于经验损失训练的分类器引导机制首次提供了可证明的可靠性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that controlling the cross-entropy at each diffusion step suffices to bound the corresponding guidance error, providing the first provable reliability guarantee for classifier guidance trained via empirical loss minimization.
